name: BattleShip
author: robin994 & Rinnegatamante
description:
PS Vita port of Super Smash Bros 64, built from a decompilation using libultraship and Torch. Renamed to avoid using the original game's name directly - it is fully playable once set up with your own ROM.
Real-hardware bring-up is ongoing; expect some rough edges around fighter models and the intro sequence on this early release.
requirements: Needs your own copy of Super Smash Bros. (N64) US NTSC v1.0. Extract BattleShip.o2r from that ROM with scripts/extract-vita-data.sh from the repo, then copy it to ux0:data/battleship/BattleShip.o2r before first launch. First launch takes extra time to compile the shader cache.
